# GAPsurvey

*At-sea data management tools for RACE GAP surveys*

> This code is always in development

## This code is primarally maintained by:

**Emily Markowitz** (Emily.Markowitz AT noaa.gov; EmilyMarkowitz-NOAA)

**Sean Rohan** (Sean.Rohan AT noaa.gov; sean-rohan-NOAA)

**Margaret Siple** (Margaret Siple AT noaa.gov; MargaretSiple-NOAA)

Alaska Fisheries Science Center,

National Marine Fisheries Service,

National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration,

Seattle, WA 98195

## Make sure the necessary packages are installed

``` r
library(devtools)

devtools::install_github("afsc-gap-products/GAPsurvey")
 # Or
remotes::install_github("afsc-gap-products/GAPsurvey@main")

library(GAPsurvey)
```

or install from local file `.tar.gz`:

``` r
# example, the user may have a different path
install.packages('C:/Users/User/Downloads/GAPsurvey_2026.04.14.tar.gz',
                 repos=NULL, type='source')
library(GAPsurvey)
```

## Cite this data

Use the below [bibtext citations](NA) for citing the package created and
maintained in this repo. Add “note = {Accessed: mm/dd/yyyy}” to append
the day this data was accessed.

``` r
cat(readLines(con = here::here("inst/CITATION.bib")), sep = "\n") 
#> @misc{GAPsurvey,
#>   author = {{NOAA Fisheries Alaska Fisheries Science Center, Goundfish Assessment Program}},
#>   year = {2024},
#>   title = {AFSC Goundfish Assessment Program at-Sea data management tools for RACE GAP surveys},
#>   howpublished = {https://www.fisheries.noaa.gov/alaska/science-data/groundfish-assessment-program-bottom-trawl-surveys},
#>   publisher = {{U.S. Dep. Commer.}},
#>   copyright = {Public Domain}
#> }
```

Markowitz et al., 2025; Siple et al., 2024; Von Szalay et al., 2023;

# Suggestions and Comments

If you see that the data, product, or metadata can be improved, you are
invited to create a [pull
request](https://github.com/afsc-gap-products/GAPsurvey/pulls), [submit
an issue to the GitHub
organization](https://github.com/afsc-gap-products/data-requests/issues),
or [submit an issue to the code’s
repository](https://github.com/afsc-gap-products/GAPsurvey/issues).

# Package index

## Marport and Globe Converters

- [`convert_log_gps()`](https://afsc-gap-products.github.io/GAPsurvey/reference/convert_log_gps.md)
  : Recover position data from Globe .log file
- [`convert_bvdr_marp()`](https://afsc-gap-products.github.io/GAPsurvey/reference/convert_bvdr_marp.md)
  : Convert .bvdr files to .marp files

## CTD Converters & Tools

- [`convert_ted_btd()`](https://afsc-gap-products.github.io/GAPsurvey/reference/convert_ted_btd.md)
  : BVDR Conversion to Create BTD data
- [`convert_ctd_btd()`](https://afsc-gap-products.github.io/GAPsurvey/reference/convert_ctd_btd.md)
  : Convert CTD data from .hex to BTD and BTH
- [`convert_nmea_btd()`](https://afsc-gap-products.github.io/GAPsurvey/reference/convert_nmea_btd.md)
  : Extract depth and temperature from NMEA strings
- [`convert_tzdb_gps()`](https://afsc-gap-products.github.io/GAPsurvey/reference/convert_tzdb_gps.md)
  : Read data from a TimeZero database and convert to a .gps file
- [`convert_xml_btd()`](https://afsc-gap-products.github.io/GAPsurvey/reference/convert_xml_btd.md)
  : Convert Marport Trident Pro temperature/depth to BTD
- [`parse_marport_nmea()`](https://afsc-gap-products.github.io/GAPsurvey/reference/parse_marport_nmea.md)
  : Parse Marport NMEA Logs into wide format data frames

## Resources

- [`get_catch_haul_history()`](https://afsc-gap-products.github.io/GAPsurvey/reference/get_catch_haul_history.md)
  : Find historical catch data from previous years
- [`get_sunrise_sunset()`](https://afsc-gap-products.github.io/GAPsurvey/reference/get_sunrise_sunset.md)
  : Get sunrise and sunset times by day, latitude, and longitude

## Datasets

- [`public_data`](https://afsc-gap-products.github.io/GAPsurvey/reference/public_data.md)
  : Presence-only public data from FOSS
- [`station_coords`](https://afsc-gap-products.github.io/GAPsurvey/reference/station_coords.md)
  : Station centroid locations for each station from akgfmaps
- [`species_data`](https://afsc-gap-products.github.io/GAPsurvey/reference/species_data.md)
  : Subsetted species data
- [`PolySpecies`](https://afsc-gap-products.github.io/GAPsurvey/reference/PolySpecies.md)
  : PolySpecies Data Set
